scope: Eight clonality/thymic-output construction/art/custody paths at both pins, plus two full embedding parents and their complete differences; a bounded asset assessment rather than a replacement ordinary-lesson denominator.

units.requirement: A repertoire is a sampled distribution of receptor identities and abundances in a named population and time; it is not a complete body-wide map of targets or function.

Clone denotes a cellular lineage, whereas a clonotype is an operational sequence grouping. One-chain and paired-receptor definitions differ in precision and depend on assay rules; shared single-chain identity need not establish one cellular lineage.

The fictional sampled clonotype-A numerator remains 10 at baseline and follow-up while the denominator changes from 1,000 to 100. Thus 10/1,000=1% and 10/100=10%: a tenfold fraction increase without a larger sampled count.
Estimating absolute expansion in blood, tissue or the whole body requires comparable sampling and calibrated counts; the two fictional sampled counts alone are not such calibration.
Repertoire comparisons need sample compartment, timing, sampling depth and chain/sequence definition. Failure to detect a receptor in one tube need not mean absence elsewhere.
Neither receptor frequency nor a dominant clonotype identifies antigen specificity, tumor recognition, functional killing, vaccine attribution or clinical benefit without separate evidence.

Diversity, evenness, expansion and total cell count are different summaries. A few expanded clones after a fictional infection can lower measured diversity without establishing a cancer response or making low diversity universally harmful.
New thymic arrivals are distinct from survival and division of cells already in the peripheral pool; the observed naive-cell pool also depends on movement and loss.
Adult thymic output can persist while generally declining with age. Involution is gradual and variable, not shutdown at a universal adult birthday or one universal output rate.
A naive phenotype does not date export from the thymus: cells can survive and divide outside it while retaining a broad naive phenotype.
TRECs are circular DNA by-products of T-cell receptor rearrangement that do not replicate with chromosomes during division; proliferation can dilute measured copies per cell.

In the invented closed ledger two cells holding four total circles divide into four cells retaining four circles. The average changes from 4/2=2 to 4/4=1 copy per cell. Entry, death and degradation are outside this toy comparison.

The fictional parents each hold two circles. One daughter pair receives 2 and 0 and the other 1 and 1; each lineage retains its two copies. Uneven allocation is one illustration, not a required distribution in every division.
A fall in copies per cell need not establish zero thymic output; output, survival, movement, division, denominator and independent measurements require separate assessment.
TREC copies per a specified number of cells and copies per blood volume use different denominators and answer different questions; concentration is not an unqualified production rate.

Cell count, phenotype, imaging and TREC content each have limits. Imaging tissue is not a direct daily export count, and none alone establishes immune age, cancer benefit or a collection recommendation.
Human and mouse maintenance mechanisms differ in the cited kinetic/modeling comparison; the mouse dependence on thymic input is not a direct human cell-banking or treatment rule.

Peripheral division maintains an existing receptor lineage; new development can add receptor identities. Neither continued output nor division guarantees a tumor-recognizing receptor on demand or rewrites each mature vaccine-responding receptor.

All eight assigned bodies are read from beginning to end in eighteen acknowledged spans; four are complete JSON, two are plain-text briefs and two are complete SVG XML. Both pinned inventories remain separate despite identical bodies.

The current-baseline repertoire review explicitly inherits a nested historical whole review and reports zero fresh captures or science/pixel rerun. Its compatibility reviewType and PASS labels do not make it a fresh whole independent review.

Original historical source/native/reader PASS, author seals and pending reviewer/adoption claims remain attestations at their actual recorded depth; no private agent, package or screenshot path is followed or republished as approval.
Named owner/preimage/output/prompt hashes are compared to both pins. Historical hash mismatches and source-commit assertions remain distinct from current byte identity and scientific support.

Four whole 600x960 native SVG views and normalized geometry/text checks do not certify hosted browser behavior, physical mobile paint, quantitative contrast, focus return or accessibility. Prior renderer metrics are not freshly reproduced.

The fixed-count tracks are two 540-unit bars with 5.4 and 54 fills, matching 1% and 10%; physical coordinates and identical cell icons are construction evidence, not a requirement for canonical record layout. TRECs and cell icons are qualitative symbols, not measured biological quantities.
One parent Mermaid diagram is read as source in both version contexts, not freshly rendered. All toy arithmetic and daughter allocation are premise-backed illustration rather than clinical data.
